'''Ion Papanoida''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the son of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora's]] [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]], and was the brother of [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]].

==Biography==
[[File:N_Papanoida_And_His_Family.png|thumb|left|200px|Ion with his father and two sisters on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
Ion accompanied his father to Coruscant, where he and his father spoke with Senator Chuchi about Trade Federation blockade of their planet. He informed her that their were crying out to join the Separatists.

When his two sisters were kidnapped by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], Ion Papanoida assisted his father in investigating his sisters' kidnapping. He then accompanied his father to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to hunt down the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], the one responsible for the kidnapping. He accompanied him to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], where they proved in front of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] that Greedo had indeed kidnapped the baron's daughters. They led Greedo to the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], where his accomplice released Chi Eekway Papanoida. The situation culminated in a shooting match when Greedo initiated a fight between the baron and the other bounty hunters. Ion Papanoida was almost [[Death/Legends|killed]] but was saved by his sister, Che Amanwe. However, Greedo escaped, but the Papanoida family was reunited.

==Behind the scenes==
Ion Papanoida is based on [[George Lucas]]' son, [[Jett Lucas]], who played [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Ion was voiced by [[Seth Green]], who had previously voiced [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] in the series.<ref name="Sphere of Influence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode304.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Sphere of Influence}}</ref>
